problem_statement: Increase bifacial gain and push module conversion efficiency above 22.5% for TOPCon/HJT cells under high-ambient Indian operating conditions.
Reduce silver paste consumption in cell front-contact metallization to lower module bill-of-materials cost.
Reduce green-hydrogen electrolyser stack cost by eliminating expensive PEM membranes and cutting part count.
Predict and extend electrolyser membrane/stack lifetime under variable renewable power to reduce stack-replacement cost.
Improve fast-charge cycle life and electrical conductivity of LFP battery cathodes with thermal stability for tropical climates.
Lower the embodied CO2 of concrete by optimizing fly-ash / GGBS geopolymer mixes while accurately predicting compressive strength.
Reduce the footprint, capex and regeneration energy of post-combustion CO2 capture from cement flue gas.
Continuously detect and localize leaks in industrial pipelines using acoustic-emission sensors without scaffolding or downtime.
Make green steel cost-competitive using hydrogen-based direct reduction and reduce coke consumption in the blast furnace.
